_provenance.warning: Container depths, volumes and first-harvest timings below are standard horticultural ranges, NOT measured Kenyan trial data. They are shipped so the kitchen-garden feature works, and each one must be confirmed against KALRO, county extension officers or a published container-gardening trial before it is quoted as fact in an article or shown to a farmer without a caveat. Do not treat these numbers as verified.

containers.notes_en: Fastest return of any container leafy green. Sow densely, thin as you harvest.
containers.notes_sw: Mchicha hukua haraka kuliko mboga nyingine za majani. Panda kwa karibu, una kadiri unavyovuna.

containers.notes_en: One plant feeds a household for months if outer leaves are picked and the crown is left.
containers.notes_sw: Mmea mmoja unaweza kutosha familia kwa miezi ukichukua majani ya nje na kuacha kiini.

containers.notes_en: Needs full sun, staking and consistent water. Fruit splits if watering swings between dry and flooded.
containers.notes_sw: Inahitaji jua kamili, kufungwa kamba na maji ya mara kwa mara. Matunda yupasuka maji yakibadilika sana.

containers.notes_en: Tolerates dry conditions and poor media better than most. Leaves are also edible.
containers.notes_sw: Inastahimili ukame na udongo mbaya kuliko nyingi. Majani pia huliwa.

containers.notes_en: A climber. Give it a balcony railing or string and it will crop over a long window.
containers.notes_sw: Ni mpanda juu. Ipe kizingiti cha roshani au kamba itazaa kwa muda mrefu.

containers.notes_en: Grown in a container for leaves from about a month; tubers need a deep sack and 4 to 5 months.
containers.notes_sw: Hupandwa kwenye chombo kwa ajili ya majani kuanzia mwezi mmoja; viazi vinahitaji gunia kirefu na miezi 4 hadi 5.
